name: 6183-rerank-llama3b-dp8
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, bf16, ~6.1 GB of safetensors. An UNGATED MIRROR of meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, under the Llama 3.2 Community License; the unsloth copy is field-for-field the same model.
parallelism: DP=8, TP=1, EP=1, PP=1. Eight complete replicas, one per GPU, each with its own scheduler and its own KV pool, behind ONE HTTP endpoint. `enable_dp_attention` is off (its default); with it on this is a different topology.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64 (8 per replica), warmup the first 10%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets: 4096 prompt tokens in and ONE token out, both FIXED at exactly that (stdev 0, min == max), temperature 0.0 passed through `spec.backend.extras.body` because that is the only legal home for a per-request knob on this backend. A scoring shape, not a chat shape.
purpose: A document relevance scorer rating 4096-token passages with a single-token verdict, 64 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang.launch_server` arguments, read as a FLAT file: one `key: value` per line. A nested block
# is DROPPED silently, which would start the engine without a setting this file claims to declare.

# An ungated bf16 mirror of the gated meta-llama repo of the same checkpoint.
model-path: unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct

# Eight complete replicas, one per GPU, each with its own scheduler and KV pool, behind one HTTP
# endpoint. `enable-dp-attention` is absent so it stays at its default of false: that is a
# different topology and not this one.
dp-size: 8
tp-size: 1

# Caps a REQUEST, not the pool. The workload's longest request is 4096 prompt + 1 output tokens;
# the checkpoint would otherwise allow 131072 positions, which is 14 GB of KV for one request.
context-length: 8192

# Matches `seed` in scenario.json, so the engine's own sampling is pinned too.
random-seed: 42
